name: DateField
description: A date, a time or both, typed one segment at a time — in the order and with the separators the reader's locale writes them, so `19.10.2026` in Moldova and `10/19/2026` in the US with nothing to configure and nothing to parse.

props.name: type
props.description: What it edits: a day (`'date'`, default), a time of day (`'time'`), or both (`'datetime'`).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value, an ISO string of the field's kind: `2026-10-19`, `14:30:00`, or for a date-time an instant with its offset (`2026-10-19T14:30:00+03:00`), `…Z` in UTC, or a wall clock with `zone="none"`. `null` is empty. Any spelling `parse` reads is accepted; what comes back is canonical.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value it starts with when the field owns its state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the new value — `null` while a segment is empty — and its readings: `utc`, the reader's `local` wall clock, a `Date`, the epoch, and why it changed.

props.name: zone
props.description: Whose wall clock a date-time is typed on. Default `'local'`, the reader's; `'utc'`, any IANA zone or `+03:00` for another; `'none'` for a wall clock with no zone at all (an alarm, a timetable). A date and a time have no zone, so this only says what "today" is for them.

props.name: locale
props.description: The language the segments are ordered and named in. Default the reader's.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: A 12- or 24-hour clock. Default the locale's.

props.name: granularity
props.description: Whether a time is edited to the minute (default) or the second.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest value that is valid. A value before it is kept and marked `aria-invalid`.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest value that is valid.

props.name: isDateUnavailable
props.description: Days nobody can choose — a weekend, a holiday. Handed the `YYYY-MM-DD` day.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not editable and not focusable, and read out as such.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable and read out, but not editable.

props.name: required
props.description: The form is not valid until it is filled in — the browser's own check, announced and translated for free.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value invalid whatever the bounds say. Default: invalid when out of bounds or unavailable.

props.name: name
props.description: What the value posts under in a form: the canonical string, or nothing while empty.

props.name: label
props.description: The field's visible name, rendered above it. A group of segments is not named by its contents.

props.name: labelledBy
props.description: Names the field after an element already on the page, instead of `label`.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: An element that describes the field — a hint, an error.

props.name: placeholderValue
props.description: What an empty segment starts from on an arrow key. Default today, at midnight.

props.name: disambiguation
props.description: What a wall-clock time a zone skips or repeats means. Default `'compatible'`.

props.name: showZone
props.description: Whether a date-time names its zone after the time. Default: when the zone is not the reader's own.

props.name: end
props.description: Something inside the field, after the segments — a picker's button.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the first segment on mount.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: What an empty segment is read out as. Default `'Empty'`.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Every segment's tab index. Default `0`; `-1` keeps the field out of the page's tab order, which a grid cell wants.

keyboard.action: Every segment is its own tab stop.
The previous or next segment, in the reading order.
One more or one less, wrapping round the segment's range.
A bigger step: five years, two months, a week, two hours, fifteen minutes.
The segment's lowest and highest value.
Types into the segment, and moves on once no further digit could fit.
AM or PM, in the AM/PM segment.
Takes back the last digit, then empties the segment, then moves to the one before.

a11y: The field is a `role="group"` named by `label`; each segment is a `role="spinbutton"` named by its unit in the reader's language (`Monat`, `месяц`), with `aria-valuetext` saying the month by name.
An empty segment still carries `aria-valuenow` (its placeholder, which is what an arrow starts from) and reads as `emptyText`.
`required` and `name` are a real input the browser validates, so an empty required field stops the form and the message is the browser's own.
